<observations>
Date: May 13–19, 2026
* 🔴 (May 13) Kitchen remodel budget set at $28,500.
* 🔴 (May 16) Backsplash tile finalized as "Sea Glass" (replacing Fog Gray); range hood upgraded to 900 CFM model ($2,750 via VentMaster Inc.).
* ✅ (May 16) Visual mock-up sent for quartz windowsill option alongside island design.
* 🔴 (May 19) Matte black "AquaFlow" faucet chosen; cabinet demolition postponed pending flooring arrival.
* ✅ (May 19) Quartz countertop slabs (9'x2') confirmed with StoneEdge Fabricators for June 5 ETA; HOA permit checklist uploaded.

Date: May 22, 2026
* 🔴 Backsplash area measured at 12.5 sq ft; selected "Honey Oak Classic" engineered oak flooring (250 sq ft from FloorCraft, delivery June 12).
* 🔴 Upper cabinets color selected as "Soft Sand" (Pantone 13-0915) from ColorHue Supplies.
* ✅ HOA approved remodel permit, clearing final obstacles.
* 🟡 Electrical rough-in scheduled for June 3 with electrician Marco Ruiz.

Date: May 26–30, 2026
* 🔴 Kitchen ceiling height is 9'2"; island length is 9'4". Selected "Cascade Ridge" waterfall edge for island quartzite (TopStone, delivery July 15) and added "Midnight Slate" quartzite (delivery Aug 5).
* 🔴 Cabinet delivery scheduled for July 2, 2026 (CabinetCraft); added built-in "Vintner 24" wine cooler beside refrigerator.
* 🔴 Pantry door updated to a 4'x6' frosted glass sliding panel (ClearView Glassworks, arrival July 12).
* 🟡 Demolition rescheduled for June 20 with foreman Luis Ortega; sink installation scheduled with EcoFlow Plumbing for July 18.
* ✅ Electrical permit amendment approved; Miller & Co. added 2 GFCI outlets.
</observations>

<current-task>
Primary: Tracking overall kitchen remodel design choices, material lead times, and scheduling milestones leading up to the June 20 demolition.
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
"We have all major selections locked in—from the Sea Glass backsplash and Soft Sand cabinets to the Honey Oak flooring and Vintner 24 wine cooler. Would you like to review the updated timeline leading up to the June 20 demolition?"
</suggested-response>
